numeric.purpose: Stable fan percentages and preset values.

shadows.name: slider-thumb
shadows.value: 0 1pt 3pt rgba(0,0,0,0.55) dark / rgba(0,0,0,0.30) light, baked into the cached thumb bitmap
shadows.purpose: The glass puck is the one raised object on the recessed coolant channel.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tactile button press.

motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Hover/selection fill cross-fade.

motion.name: glide
motion.purpose: Thumb, coolant, rime reveal and halo for pointer jumps, preset clicks and model changes. Keyboard (arrows, 1-6, M) is instant.

motion.name: mode-pill
motion.purpose: Auto/Manual selection.

motion.name: ice-formation
motion.value: 620ms freezing front from the thumb to 70%, rim crystals grow, glint rides it; glint returns and frosts the thumb with a needle burst (1.25s total)
motion.purpose: A user reaching 100% cooling freezes the top of the channel into a sheet (Expressive only).

motion.name: melt
motion.value: 420ms ease-in-out from wherever the front is; plates fade, rim crystals retract
motion.purpose: Ice melts when cooling is lowered; an interrupted formation never snaps to full.

motion.name: release-sweep
motion.purpose: Light runs back along the coolant after a pointer release.

motion.name: thumb-grab
motion.value: 260ms keyframe squash to 1.26×0.88, then held 1.12×1.06; release spring (stiffness 380, damping 13)
motion.purpose: The glass puck answers grab and release.

motion.name: drag-speed
motion.value: additive lean (max 8°, spring 240/11), stretch (max +35%, 380ms), head surge, coolant slosh; 40 pt/s dead zone
motion.purpose: Momentum from fast drags; slow precise adjustment stays still. Expressive full, Subtle 45%, Off none.

motion.name: wake
motion.value: 420ms fade and retract into the thumb; preset/track glide shoots light to the target
motion.purpose: A short cold wake from actual movement (Expressive).

motion.name: ripple
motion.value: 440ms ring along the channel (620ms wide on release)
motion.purpose: Grab, release and preset detents (Expressive).

motion.name: rime-melt
motion.purpose: Rime lowered by a drag melts back behind the thumb; the coolant never lags.

motion.name: slider-style-switch
motion.value: instant; transients settled, static state (including formed ice) redrawn
motion.purpose: Settings → Slider swaps Channel and Dot Grid skins without touching the value or the fan.

motion.name: temperature-roll
motion.purpose: Temperature figure changes.

motion.name: aura
motion.purpose: Heat band change; a rising band breathes in once.

motion.name: percent-roll
motion.purpose: Requested percentage turns over on a preset click; drags and keys never roll.

motion.name: chill
motion.purpose: Cold air at the lower edge follows measured fan speed as the fan spins up or down.

motion.name: trend-inspect
motion.purpose: Hairline, probe and exact value for the sample under the pointer.

motion.name: key-acknowledge
motion.purpose: A preset applied by its number key.

motion.name: editor-row
motion.purpose: A newly added preset row settles in; focus edge 150ms.

motion.name: section-swap
motion.purpose: Fan section ↔ Settings.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: System Reduce Motion removes all movement; static state remains.

narrative.overview: Aervane is a compact native macOS menu-bar instrument. Temperature leads; direct percentage control follows. Layout and controls carry state with minimal copy. Point of view: warm light behind the glass, frost on it — heat glows behind the reading, measured airflow chills the lower edge, the cooling command runs as coolant light through a channel in the glass, grows rime and freezes into sheet ice at full cooling.
keyCharacteristics: Heat behind the glass, frost on it
Ice for cooling, heat for temperature

rules.name: The State Must Speak Rule
rules.body: Use plain-language state labels with semantic color; color never carries status alone.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced digits for values that change during interaction.

rules.name: The Material First Rule
rules.body: Use native glass and tonal separation before adding shadow.

rules.name: The Two Families Rule
rules.body: Cooling is never warm and heat is never icy.

rules.name: The Measured Air Rule
rules.body: Atmosphere that describes the fan follows measured speed, never the request; requested speed lives on the slider.

dos: Keep temperature first and the direct percentage control immediately available.
Preserve the hardware minimum and distinguish requested from measured speed.
Let every core action work from the keyboard without capturing text-field keys.
Edit presets on a draft: Save stores, Cancel discards, closing the panel keeps edits.
Keep slider styles presentation-only: one control, one input path, one set of fan semantics.
donts: Do not add taglines, footers or section labels.
Do not describe preview as applied.
Do not add idle animation, timers or particles.
Do not let a heat state imply that manual control is blocked.
Do not use literal snowflakes or falling snow; frost is grain, crystal and sheet ice on the slider channel.
